value.rationale: The fixed-point-free map is a distance-preserving order-preserving affine embedding of the entire unit ball into the sphere, stronger than qualitative BFPP failure. It is valid on all infinite ordinal spaces, including nonmetrizable spaces of uncountable cofinality where continuity at limits matters. Exact residuals and sharp rate for every fixed averaging parameter give a precise nonexpansive-dynamics example.
